components.label: Recap ImageResponse composition
components.purpose: Real generated whole-session artwork, not an in-app React card.

motion.label: Global reduced-motion policy
motion.trigger: Operating-system prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.
motion.accessibility: All elements and pseudo-elements get 0.01ms animation/transition durations, one animation iteration and auto scroll; mode transitions are set to none. Animation delays are not globally cleared, so initially opacity-zero staggered content still needs rendered inspection.

motion.label: useColorMode / applyColorMode
motion.trigger: Explicit light/dark choice or changed system preference after first application adds a 300ms global color/background/border/shadow transition.
motion.accessibility: First paint is applied synchronously without transition; prefers-reduced-motion disables the transition class. Native radio checked/focus state communicates selection without motion; localStorage failure falls back gracefully.

motion.label: useVisualViewport
motion.trigger: visualViewport resize/scroll plus window resize/orientationchange are coalesced in requestAnimationFrame into height and offset CSS variables.
motion.accessibility: Functional keyboard/safe-area geometry, not decorative animation. Necessary under reduced motion too. Real mobile keyboard, landscape and text zoom must be inspected because desktop dimensions do not reproduce overlay keyboards.

motion.label: Writing focus and round reset
motion.trigger: Textarea focus schedules scrollIntoView(nearest) after 300ms; changing poem/line resets window scroll to top.
motion.accessibility: Both scroll paths explicitly use auto, not smooth. Labelled textarea and manual Enter suppression keep input single-line; check that focus/scroll does not hide the carried line or action zone with the keyboard.

motion.label: Shared button and native control feedback
motion.trigger: Primary press translates 2px and crushes shadow; secondary/outline/ghost scale to 0.96; heart active scales to 0.90; input/button use transitions; success may add stamp.
motion.accessibility: Visible focus rings and native disabled state exist. Global reduced-motion shortens duration, but instantaneous :active transforms remain because the transforms themselves are not removed.

motion.label: StampAnimation / animate-stamp
motion.trigger: Lobby roster mount with i*150ms delay; stampAnimate prop on submit/share success; 404 mount. Scale 0 to 1.08 to 1 with rotation over duration-slow (400ms).
motion.accessibility: Global reduced-motion uses near-zero duration/one iteration but preserves delay; wrapper uses backwards fill, so delayed arrivals can remain hidden briefly. Text must remain understandable with animation disabled.

motion.label: Loading pulse and auth spinner
motion.trigger: Guest/room/reveal loading pulses a dot; archive loading pulses six cards and stats; poem detail pulses raw Loading text; account callback spins a circle.
motion.accessibility: LoadingState and callback expose polite busy status; archive skeletons and raw poem loader do not use the same full status semantics. Global reduced-motion shortens animation and stops repetition.

motion.label: Common fade/slide entrances
motion.trigger: Initial or conditional render moves 12px upward while becoming opaque; writing coachmark/carried line/Ready/confirmation, help content, archive cards and error copy use this.
motion.accessibility: Global reduced-motion guard exists. The effects are independently triggered rather than an orchestrated phase transition; verify screen-reader content remains available and focus is not motion-dependent.

motion.label: Archive stagger and hover detail
motion.trigger: Featured card enters first; remaining cards delay (index+1)*50ms; hover lifts card, changes border/shadow, reveals read arrow and a line-count badge; favorite scales on hover/press.
motion.accessibility: Reduced-motion shortens durations but leaves delays and hover transforms. Line-count badge depends on mouse hover state rather than focus; navigation and favorite must remain usable on touch/keyboard.

motion.label: Poem silhouette bar reveal
motion.trigger: PoemCard mouse hover passes animate=true: each bar scales horizontally and fades over 400ms with index*50ms delay.
motion.accessibility: Whole silhouette has role=img and a word-count-pattern label. Reduced-motion duration override still leaves stagger delays; bar shape must not stay invisible in reduced-motion snapshots.

motion.label: AuthorDots hover and stagger
motion.trigger: Each tiny contributor dot scales to 1.25 on hover with index*20ms transition delay.
motion.accessibility: Group announces contributor count; dots are nonfocusable and title labels say Contributor N rather than human names. Global reduced-motion shortens transitions but hover transform remains.

motion.label: Active writer presence pulse
motion.trigger: Active, non-away, nonspectator avatar gets an inline 2s infinite pulse from scale 1 to 1.8 and opacity .6 to 0; submitted names are dimmed/struck through.
motion.accessibility: Global reduced-motion limits the pulse to one near-zero iteration. Actual submitted/waiting text and polite waiting-name announcements carry state independently of animation; avatar animationDelay alone does not add an entrance.

motion.label: useRoundClock and soft pacing line
motion.trigger: Server round start anchors 1-second ticking; 2px bar narrows through the 90s soft window, warms in last quarter, becomes full width at 35% opacity in overtime.
motion.accessibility: Timer never blocks submission and is aria-hidden/presentation; no spoken numeric countdown. motion-reduce:transition-none removes interpolation while time updates remain functional.

motion.label: WordSlots fill and overflow feedback
motion.trigger: Typing changes empty/filled/exact/overflow chip colors; count-only variant applies small filled-slot delays.
motion.accessibility: WordSlots has role=status/accessible count, WritingComposer separately debounces Add/Remove/Ready announcements by 500ms. Specific motion-reduce transition removal exists; verify duplicate live announcements and long-word containment.

motion.label: Writing ready-state emphasis
motion.trigger: Exact word target while idle renders Ready fade-up text and an infinite 1250ms expanding shadow ring around Submit.
motion.accessibility: Count and enabled button convey readiness without ring. Global reduced-motion suppresses repetition. New direction should decide if an idle repeating cue is useful or noisy, not assume it must remain.

motion.label: Submit confirmation and waiting handoff
motion.trigger: Successful persistence shows confirmed stored text with fade-up and stamped button; waits 1500ms before WaitingScreen unless server already advances assignment.
motion.accessibility: Draft only clears on confirmed/already-submitted state; confirmation delay is functional state timing and is not changed by CSS reduced motion. Full-page waiting changes need keyboard/focus and announcement inspection.

motion.label: Poem author-marker reveal
motion.trigger: Selecting a 44px author marker reveals an absolutely positioned author name with 500ms opacity transition; clears after 2s.
motion.accessibility: Marker has accessible Show author for line N label and focus ring; hidden attribution uses aria-hidden. No explicit live announcement or name in button label; 2s timeout is not relaxed for assistive technology.

motion.label: Help modal entrance and focus lifecycle
motion.trigger: Open mounts 300ms backdrop fade and fade-up panel; close unmounts immediately.
motion.accessibility: Close button autofocus, Tab trap, aria-modal and Escape handling exist; body scroll locks. Code does not explicitly restore previous focus on close or constrain dialog max-height, both need actual browser inspection.

motion.label: Header/room/entry popover controls
motion.trigger: Menu/QR/appearance panels mount immediately; hover/focus/checked state changes use color/all transitions.
motion.accessibility: Native mode radios support arrows. Appearance dialogs are nonmodal; Escape restores owner-specific trigger. Inspect outside-click regions, focus handoff and 45dvh bounded scrolling on cramped screens.

motion.label: Reveal reading focus and announcements
motion.trigger: First unrevealed row changes focus; poem overlay focuses a hidden heading; stage active/headline poem focuses reader heading. Whole poem appears together.
motion.accessibility: Polite status announces transition/reader, not the poem text. No current line-by-line animation; preserve complete reading order and test return focus when closing/finishing.

motion.label: Stage join highlight
motion.trigger: New player ID receives background tint and Just joined chip for 1600ms; colors transition.
motion.accessibility: Roster text communicates arrival; no separate live arrival announcement is implemented in this component. Motion reduction does not remove timed chip state.

motion.label: Room-favorite crown and burst
motion.trigger: Favorite card mount includes 900ms heart-burst and 760ms dropping/rotating crown-settle; a new leader ID invokes punctuate(crown).
motion.accessibility: Burst/crown are decorative; favorite text and heart count remain. Global reduced-motion shortens visuals; ceremony hook suppresses sound/haptic. Existing DOM is not keyed to leader ID, so visual retrigger on leader changes needs inspection.

motion.label: useCeremonyEffects audio/haptic gating
motion.trigger: The only located punctuate call is crown on favorite leader change. PoemDisplay exposes mute only. Hook also defines line/final-line events but no app/components caller triggers them.
motion.accessibility: Persisted mute defaults false; reduced-motion disables both sound and vibration. OS support/autoplay may prevent effects, exceptions are best-effort. Text/visual ceremony remains usable with no audio. Hook instances do not subscribe to storage/mute changes in other instances.

motion.label: Account profile image filter
motion.trigger: Authenticated profile image is grayscale until hover and transitions to color.
motion.accessibility: Decorative transform only; no information should depend on hover. Global reduced-motion shortens the transition, not the filter difference.

motion.label: Defined but unmounted motion
motion.trigger: animate-type, animate-breathe and animate-final-line-settle/wipe keyframes are defined but no current app/components use was found. AuthShowcase line and WaitingScreen list animationDelay values alone do not cause animation.
motion.accessibility: No claim that these effects render. If retained in a direction, establish intentional triggers and reduced-motion alternatives; do not inherit dead effects as obligations.

sensory.label: Existing visual identity is replaceable
sensory.role: Historical Ink & Anticipation pairs paper/ink tones with rust-orange accent, Libre Baskerville display, IBM Plex Sans body and JetBrains Mono labels. Operator reopens all identity choices; only mechanics/privacy/accessibility/mobile/guest obligations remain constraints.

sensory.label: Wordmark and generated circular mark
sensory.role: Text wordmark is repeated in app chrome and artifacts; generated social/full-card compositions include a rotated solid circular accent. No separate Logo React component exists. New logo, imagery and brand expression are explicitly in scope for exploration.

sensory.label: Browser and installation icon assets
sensory.role: Actual shipped binary icons and standalone manifest are a design surface. Source inventory has not visually inspected their pixels; Main must inspect them. Manifest currently hardcodes white theme/background colors.

sensory.label: Grain, paper, blur and shadows
sensory.role: Global 3% SVG turbulence texture, .paper borders/shadow, offset rust-tinted token shadows, translucent blurred room trays and extra localized 404 grain/blur form the current material language; all may be replaced.

sensory.label: Type roles and local text styling
sensory.role: Three font families, custom modular scale, widely used tracked mono uppercase labels and italic poem teasers define the current voice. UI, Clerk forms and server-generated image fonts must all be considered in any direction.

sensory.label: Player and author identity markers
sensory.role: Deterministic 12-color palette with collision resolution; 8–20px avatars, contributor dots and optional real provider photo. Stable names and authorship are obligations; colors/dot-only identity can become expressive avatars or shapes without new game mechanics.

sensory.label: Nine-line poem shape
sensory.role: The 1–2–3–4–5–4–3–2–1 constraint appears as word chips, miniature diamond-like bars, a help sequence and social-card art. Preserve rule truth, not the manuscript/seal metaphor.

sensory.label: Shared icon vocabulary
sensory.role: Lucide icons cover archive/help/palette/invite, crown authority/favorite, heart, presentation, sound/mute, download and print; inline SVG favorite/RSS also exist. Design each symbol consistently with a clear label or accessible name; do not make decorative icon inventory into fake components.

sensory.label: Synthesized ceremony tones
sensory.role: WebAudio generates short 120ms tones with gain peak .035: line 440Hz sine and final-line 660Hz sine are defined but uncalled; crown 740Hz triangle is the current live caller. A new AudioContext is made per effect and closed after 160ms. Default unmuted, persisted mute and reduced-motion suppression; no background music or speech synthesis in these hooks.

sensory.label: Ceremony vibration patterns
sensory.role: navigator.vibrate patterns: line 8ms, final-line [14,30,18], crown [16,40,22]; only crown currently invoked. Same mute/reduced-motion gate as audio; device capability dependent, never required to understand state.

sensory.label: Public preview and private full-image artifacts
sensory.role: Distinct artifact compositions: generic unavailable preview, public teaser, full attributed downloadable PNG and whole-set social preview. Preview stays light; full image follows applied mode. Private save is not public sharing; all human attribution must survive.

sensory.label: Native share, download and print affordances
sensory.role: OS share sheets and browser print/download UI are external surfaces invoked by app controls. There is no custom ShareDialog or ExportDialog component; inventory records the real triggers, cancellation and feedback instead.

sensory.label: Auth poem example and optional provider imagery
sensory.role: Desktop account entry displays latest explicitly public human poem or static sample words; profile may display Clerk image. No generic stock photo, mascot or illustration component is currently mounted; introducing one is an exploration choice, not an existing mechanics obligation.
